jobs.description:
Your mandate: execution, ownership and results 
You will personally lead the on-site execution of a major industrial project while overseeing several others, with individual projects worth several million euros. Your responsibility extends from site mobilisation and execution through handover and contractual and financial close-out.
 
This is neither a design-engineering position nor a remote project oversight role. You will be close to the work, teams, subcontractors and customers — while maintaining control of safety, quality, deadlines, budgets, margins and contractual commitments.
 Where you will make the difference  
• Deliver on site. Set execution priorities, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and subcontractors, resolve operational issues and ensure safe, high-quality delivery. 
• Protect project performance. Own budgets, forecasts, costs, cash flow and margins; spot deviations early and act before they affect results. 
• Manage contractual complexity. Anticipate risks, handle variations and claims, contribute to negotiations and safeguard customer relationships, including in public-sector projects. 
• Lead and develop people. Guide a team of approximately five to six project professionals, building accountability, confidence and stronger project practices. 
• Create clarity. Use practical planning, reporting and project reviews to turn complex situations into timely decisions — without unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 
• At least 7 years managing complex industrial projects, including substantial, hands-on responsibility for on-site execution. 
• At least 3 years in project management roles, with proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams. 
• Strong financial and contractual judgement: budgets, margins, forecasts, risk, negotiation and claims. 
• A sound technical foundation, ideally in mechanical, electromechanical, civil or industrial engineering; other educational backgrounds are welcome with substantial relevant experience. 
•  Fluent French and English; basic Dutch is an advantage. Experience with public procurement is particularly valuable.  
Above all, you enjoy the reality of industrial sites. You are pragmatic, structured and decisive; you can challenge technical choices, understand their commercial consequences and bring people with you.

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist Fiber Lasers & Press Brakes - Europe
jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs.

 Job at a glance

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

 
Your new role
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.

You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.

What will you do?

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer – Financial Control, Reporting & Process Improvement
jobs.description:
As a Finance Officer, you join the Administration Division of an international intergovernmental organisation promoting free trade and economic integration. You take hands-on responsibility for financial control and reporting while leading initiatives to improve administrative and financial processes.
 

You report directly to the Head of Finance and work within a four-person finance team. The department manages the organisation’s finances across offices in Brussels, Luxembourg and Geneva, as well as its Financial Mechanism Office.
 

This position is exclusively open to nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The starting date is as soon as possible and no later than 1 March 2027. The application deadline is 18 October 2026.
 

Je verantwoordelijkheden:
 
 

• Preparing financial reports and analyses. 

• Performing accounting controls. 

• Coordinating the year-end closing process. 

• Managing projects to improve business processes within the Administration Division. 

• Overseeing procurement activities. 

• Overseeing contract management. 

• Overseeing travel management. 

• Acting as Head of Finance when required. 
 

• Nationality of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland is an essential eligibility requirement. 

• A master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or another relevant field is required. 

• At least five years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, controlling, audit and/or consulting provides the necessary professional foundation. 

• A solid understanding of accounting, controlling and reporting is essential. 

• Practical experience with at least one accounting software package is required. 

• Excellent command of MS Excel supports your daily work. 

• Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. 

• A structured and analytical mindset characterises your approach. 

• Strong interpersonal skills allow you to collaborate effectively with colleagues. 

• You demonstrate commitment, motivation and initiative. 

• At least two years of consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Experience with payroll and public procurement would be an asset. 

• Knowledge of MS Dynamics 365 Finance and Power BI, including Power Query and Power Pivot, offers added value. 

• Experience as an IT systems superuser and/or with systems implementation is an advantage. 

• Project management experience and the ability to lead business improvement processes are valuable. 

• Previous work in an international environment is a plus. 

• Self-reliance, autonomy and a proactive approach complete your profile.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools
